references.text: God promises to put words in Moses' mouth, the same expression used here about Balaam.
God promises to put His words in the prophet's mouth, the same concept of divine inspiration of speech.
The Lord puts His words in His servant's mouth, the same formulation regarding divine revelation.
The Lord touches Jeremiah's mouth and puts His words there, parallel to how God gave Balaam the message.
Earlier in the story, Balaam is told to speak only what God puts in his mouth.
The same action is repeated when the Lord again puts words in Balaam's mouth before the next prophecy.
Balaam confirms that he can only speak what the Lord puts in his mouth.
